stem.text: A sample of food was heated with Benedict’s solution which changed colour to green.
A second sample of the same food was boiled with dilute hydrochloric acid and neutralised using sodium hydrogencarbonate. It was then heated with Benedict’s solution which changed colour to red.

stem.alt: Venn diagram of three overlapping circles labelled glucose present (top), reducing sugar present (bottom left) and non-reducing sugar present (bottom right), with regions labelled A, B, C and D.
